source_title: Monitors & Alerts are in Early Access
claim_summary: Alerts split into Monitors (detection conditions that create issues; Crons and Uptime moved here) and Alerts (notification routing reusable across monitors); existing metric alerts migrated to Metric Monitors
limitation: Migration side effects and plan limits not documented in entry; GA follows as CI2026-039-006 dup group

source_title: Improper authentication on SAML SSO process allows user identity linking (GHSA-rcmw-7mc7-3rj7; CVE-2026-42354)
claim_summary: Critical (CVSS 9.1) SAML SSO identity-linking flaw; self-hosted vulnerable only with multiple organizations enabled and a malicious user able to edit another org's SSO; patched 26.4.1; SaaS fixed with no customer action
limitation: GitHub page shows Apr 22 and affected < 26.4.0 while GitLab advisory DB shows published Apr 30 and affected < 26.4.1; SaaS fix date left as placeholder on advisory; no exploitation data

source_title: Sentry Launches Seer Agent, Enabling Developers to Investigate Any Production Problem in Plain Language
claim_summary: Natural-language investigation agent over errors spans logs traces and code context; in Sentry UI and Slack threads; beta available to all users; changelog entry dated Apr 29
limitation: Vendor quotes (hours to minutes; 4M developers / 150k orgs) are unverified marketing claims; press release Apr 28 and changelog Apr 29 are one event

source_title: Sentry's Perforce Integration is now Generally Available
claim_summary: Perforce P4 integration GA for all organizations: stack-trace linking to depots / P4 Code Review, changelist commit tracking, suspect commits and suggested assignees
limitation: No limitations stated in entry; suspect-commit accuracy not independently measured

source_title: Sentry Introduces Application Metrics: High-Cardinality, Trace-Connected Metrics for Application Debugging
claim_summary: Application Metrics announced generally available; metric events stored unaggregated and linked to originating trace; changelog lists GA on same date
availability: GA per vendor; changelog: 5 GB included on all plans then 0.50 USD per GB
limitation: Storage/cost implications of unaggregated metrics not quantified; vendor adoption figures unverified

source_title: Monitors & Alerts — Now Generally Available
claim_summary: Monitors (span attributes logs custom metrics; Crons and Uptime) and Alerts (Slack email PagerDuty routing across projects) declared GA; metric alerts migrated to Metric Monitors; existing alert rules now routing only
limitation: No limitations listed; same capability line as Apr 20 early access (CI2026-039-001)

source_title: Seer's Claude integration is now generally available
claim_summary: After Seer root-cause analysis, users can send the issue to Claude Agent to write a fix and open a pull request; configured with a customer-supplied Claude workspace API key
limitation: Customer pays separate model API usage; fix acceptance rate and review cost not reported; Apr 8 initial launch is pre-window

source_title: Seer can send bugs to GitHub Copilot for the fix. Now in open beta.
claim_summary: Seer root-cause context can be handed to GitHub Copilot coding agent; open beta for Seer customers; Copilot Business/Enterprise only, Pro/Pro+ coming soon
limitation: Beta; later GA entry Jun 30 is the same capability line (dup group)

source_title: Span Attribute Scrubbing Fix for http.query, url.query, and url.full
claim_summary: Relay excluded http.query url.query and url.full span attributes from data scrubbing regardless of rules; fixed (relay PR 5995); customers relying on default scrubbing told to review historical data
availability: fixed; GHSA says SaaS fixed May 13 and relay 26.5.0 patched
limitation: Severity Low per GHSA; start date of url.full exposure not stated; affected-data volume unknown

source_title: AI-Detected Issues Now Generally Available
claim_summary: Model-based detection over traces and logs, on by default, surfacing HTTP Database Runtime Performance Security and Code Health issues missed by rule-based detectors
limitation: No precision/recall or false-positive rates published in entry; default-on raises triage-load question

source_title: Codecov in Sentry has been removed
claim_summary: Codecov organization setting inside Sentry removed; users directed to standalone app.codecov.io
limitation: Reason not stated; does not by itself indicate any change to standalone Codecov

source_title: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity in Sentry (GHSA-jjqr-wqg2-p856; CVE-2026-52794)
claim_summary: High (CVSS 7.5, availability only) ReDoS on attacker-controlled fields in event ingestion; affected 24.4.0 to before 26.5.2; SaaS fixed; self-hosted must upgrade to 26.5.2 (released Jun 2)
limitation: CVE/OSV record published Jun 24 vs GitHub advisory Jun 3; no exploitation data

source_title: The Sentry API endpoints your agents use are now fully documented
claim_summary: Ten more API endpoints documented (tracing profiling attachments releases source maps); optional parameters documented; OpenAPI spec mismatches that broke generated clients fixed
limitation: Documentation completeness is vendor-asserted; generated-client correctness not independently tested

source_title: Enhanced Issue Grouping
claim_summary: Grouping model trained on stack traces from consenting projects replaces off-the-shelf code embeddings; vendor reports 50 percent fewer incorrect merges and 20 percent fewer duplicate issues
availability: vendor-stated deployed; rollout and plans not stated
limitation: Reduction figures are vendor-internal with no published denominator, test set or baseline period

source_title: Seer can now hand off to GitHub Copilot to write the fix for you
claim_summary: Send to GitHub Copilot from completed Seer root-cause analysis; resulting PR linked back in Sentry; requires Copilot Pro Pro+ Business or Enterprise
limitation: Entry does not literally say GA though slug contains GA; same capability line as CI2026-039-008

source_title: New Issue Type: Low-Value Spans (Beta)
claim_summary: Flags high-frequency low-information spans with projected 30-day volume and storage cost; offers removal snippet and Seer can apply the fix
availability: open beta; Business and Enterprise only; hidden from default search
limitation: Cost estimate is vendor billing estimate, not energy or lifecycle measurement

source_title: Seer now supports GitLab
claim_summary: Seer reads GitLab repository files during root-cause analysis and can open GitLab merge requests with proposed fixes
limitation: Self-managed GitLab not addressed; an AI-generated third-party digest (releases.sh) reads this as Seer leaving beta, which conflicts with Seer GA blog dated 2025-06-17

source_title: Automated agent triage with Agent Tracing and Claude Routines
claim_summary: Sentry team describes a scheduled Claude Routine reviewing about 800 nightly Seer agent conversations via Sentry MCP and filing Linear tickets for untracked problems
availability: how-to pattern using existing products; not a product release
limitation: Single internal team; no controlled comparison, error rate of model judgment or time savings reported

source_title: We're Changing Our TLS Certificate Authority in February 2027
claim_summary: Ingestion and web endpoints to move from DigiCert to Google Trust Services and Let's Encrypt in February 2027; certificate pinners and very old platforms must act
availability: announced for Feb 2027; exact cutover date to follow
limitation: Future change; not executed in window

source_title: From one switch to a control panel: meet dataCollection
claim_summary: dataCollection replaces boolean sendDefaultPii (JS SDK since 10.57.0; default in v11); v11 defaults collect user info and genAI inputs/outputs which v10 did not
limitation: More permissive defaults in v11 are a privacy-risk change for agents and LLM apps; other SDKs on separate timelines

source_title: Agent Tracing is now GA
claim_summary: Agent runs recorded as spans in existing traces (model calls, tool executions, sub-agent handoffs, token usage and cost) with conversation view; under Explore > Agents
availability: GA per vendor; pricing not stated
limitation: Token cost shown is provider-price derived, not energy; supported frameworks only in docs

source_title: Seer now iterates on the pull requests it opens
claim_summary: Seer pushes follow-up commits to its own PRs on CI failures (automatic attempts capped), Sentry feedback, @sentry comments or review comments from write-access reviewers
limitation: Cap value not stated; changes are proposals requiring review; no acceptance-rate data

source_title: JavaScript SDK v11
claim_summary: Breaking major release: no longer takes over user OpenTelemetry setup; run-time and build-time instrumentation; span streaming; dataCollection replaces sendDefaultPii; enableLogs removed; new AI provider integrations
availability: released; migration guide v10 to v11
limitation: Breaking changes impose downstream migration cost not measured here; SDK license not re-verified at pinned tag

source_title: Seer Agent now manages more of Sentry for you and connects to external telemetry
claim_summary: Seer Agent can now write via Sentry API (dashboards monitors alerts issue assign/resolve/archive saved queries) using user permissions with confirmation when scope lacking; Seer Connectors pull Datadog and Google Cloud telemetry
limitation: External connectors use API keys not OAuth; vendor blog Oct 2 says finer-grained access controls not yet available

source_title: Sentry MCP: Manage Alerts and Metric Monitors, link external issues
claim_summary: MCP tools to create update delete alerts and metric monitors (new alerts:write OAuth scope), link/unlink Jira GitHub GitLab Bitbucket Azure DevOps tickets or GitHub PRs, suspect-commit details; npm @sentry/mcp-server 0.40.0-0.42.0 has alert tools only
limitation: Repo getsentry/sentry-mcp is FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0 (source-available, not OSI open source until change date); write tools enlarge agent blast radius

source_title: Connect Sentry to Origin
claim_summary: Integration with Origin code hosting: stack-trace linking, CODEOWNERS import, release commit tracking, fixes SHORT-ID issue resolution
limitation: Origin's operator/owner not identified on the page; not verified here

source_title: Agent Tracing improvements for JavaScript SDKs
claim_summary: Auto-instrumentation on Node Bun Cloudflare Deno since 11.0.0 for more AI frameworks/providers and MCP servers; gen_ai.evaluate spans; genAI inputs and outputs collected by default (dataCollection.genAI)
availability: released in JS SDK v11 line
limitation: Default capture of prompts/outputs is a privacy and secrets exposure risk for agent workloads
